description: Use when the user names a company and wants its current open roles, e.g. "is Stripe hiring engineers in London?" or "list this company's remote jobs". Reads the public Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby job board and returns title, location, department, remote flag, job URL and posting date, newest first. company = board slug (stripe in boards.greenhouse.io/stripe); if not found on one ATS, retry the other two. For companies newly hiring across the market use list_hiring_signals.

ats.description: Applicant tracking system that hosts the job board. Unknown? Try greenhouse, then lever, then ashby.

company.description: Job-board slug from the careers URL, e.g. stripe.

location.description: Text that must appear in the location, e.g. London.

offset.description: Jobs to skip; use next_offset from the previous result.

q.description: Text that must appear in the job title, e.g. engineer.

remote.description: true = only remote jobs, false = only non-remote jobs. Omit for all.

name: list_company_jobs
title: List one company's open jobs (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby)
